description: This file defines a utility class 'Utils' in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package, providing static methods for stream manipulation, request modification, URI handling, and other helper functions used internally within the HTTP message processing library.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for stream operations, request modifications, URI handling, and other helper functions within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library.

methods.name: caselessRemove
methods.description: Removes specified keys from data array case-insensitively.

methods.name: copyToStream
methods.description: Copies data from a source stream to a destination stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: copyToString
methods.description: Reads data from a stream into a string up to a maximum length.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Calculates a hash of a stream using a specified algorithm.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Clones and modifies an HTTP request with specified changes.

methods.name: readLine
methods.description: Reads a line from a stream up to a maximum length.

methods.name: streamFor
methods.description: Creates a StreamInterface object from various resource types, strings, or callables.

methods.name: tryFopen
methods.description: Safely opens a file stream, throwing an exception on failure.

methods.name: uriFor
methods.description: Returns a UriInterface for a given string or UriInterface, creating a new Uri if needed.
